text:
inc_bot: PAGER: SEV2 - elevated 5xx & TLS handshakes failing at edge gateway (multiple customers). Alerting policy: gateway_tls_handshake_rate > 5% for 5m. Pages sent to @matt_oncall.

matt_oncall: Saw it. Re-routing to thread. I'm oncall and taking this. Anyone seeing customer reports? :eyes: 

nina_support: Multiple customers reporting 502/524 errors in the hosted API. Support ticket queue filled with 'TLS handshake' errors in logs. Sample customer error: "upstream tls handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate"

sarah_platform: Metrics show a spike in 525/526 on gateway egress to model-serving clusters starting 1768405000. Latency up ~2x for impacted requests. LB health for gateway-host-3 flapped.

matt_oncall: Pulling gateway logs now. Looks like cert verify failures from our proxy to backend and also client-side handshake failures from customer-facing LB.

alejandra_security: I'm seeing CA validation errors in the mTLS logs. Recent cert rotation job finished ~1768404800. Could be rotation introduced wrong chain or missing intermediate.

matt_oncall: Can you paste the specific error lines?

alejandra_security: Sure — from gateway logs:
```
2026-03-15T12:05:07Z gateway[proxy]: TLS error: tls: handshake failure; remote error: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
2026-03-15T12:05:07Z gateway[proxy]: verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
```

sarah_platform: I also grabbed an envoy access log snippet showing client cert flags: "verified_client_cert": false for a bunch of connections.

matt_oncall: Hypothesis: rotation job uploaded new cert chain to the gateways but did not include the intermediate CA that our internal CAs require. That would break mTLS and also cause client-side verification failures.

nina_support: Customers affected are on dedicated and hosted API frontends in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Support is adding customers to incident tracker: INC-20260315-09.

sarah_platform: Impact table: ~18% of traffic hit 5xx on ingress for 12m window, error budget breach risk if not mitigated.

matt_oncall: Mitigation options: 1) Roll back cert to previous chain (fast if we still have it on artifact store) 2) Re-deploy rotation job with corrected chain 3) Temporarily disable client-cert verification on edge (only as last resort). I prefer 1.

alejandra_security: We have the previous cert bundle in secrets-store: `s3://redwood-secrets/certs/gateway_bundle_v20260228.pem`. I can trigger a rollback. But need approval from platform to rotate live gateways.

sarah_platform: I'll coordinate the rollback. Plan: take gateway-host-3 out of LB, swap cert, reload proxy, run smoke tests, then bring back. We'll do in parallel for hosts showing flapping.

matt_oncall: Execute. Notify customers if wider impact expected. Keep me posted.

deploy-bot: deploy request queued by sarah_platform — id: deploy-9874. Rolling restart scheduled across gateway pool with max-unavailable=2.

sarah_platform: Rolling cert rollback started on host-3 now. Command I ran:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-secrets/certs/gateway_bundle_v20260228.pem /etc/ssl/certs/gateway_bundle.pem && sudo systemctl reload gateway-proxy
```
alejandra_security: After swapping bundle on host-3, we're seeing successful handshakes and client cert verified=true in logs. Pushing to host-4 and host-7 next.

nina_support: Support COA updated: temporary reroute for critical customers to unaffected region (us-east-1) in case they keep seeing errors. Support messages updated with status and ETA ~ +15m.

sarah_platform: Host-4 and host-7 rolled. Rolling window shows errors dropping to baseline. Gateway health returning.

matt_oncall: Confirming metrics — TLS handshake failure rate back to ~0.3% in 5m. Latency recovering. Marking immediate mitigations as successful.

alejandra_security: Root cause: cert rotation job omitted the intermediate CA when packaging the new bundle. Postmortem action items: (a) add automated validation that chain verifies against our CA pool before rollout, (b) keep 1-week hot backup of previous bundles in secrets-store with immutable tags, (c) add smoke-check that validates mTLS handshakes after rotation.

sarah_platform: I'll open the follow-up ticket for platform runbook updates and automation: PLATFORM-1321. Assigning to sarah_platform and alejandra_security.

nina_support: Notifying affected customers and adding incident note to their tickets.

matt_oncall: Great work team. I'll start the incident timeline and draft the postmortem. Keep any remaining logs/commands in here for the writeup.

alejandra_security: Adding snippet of failing rotation config for postmortem:
```
rotation_job:
  cert_bundle_path: "/tmp/new_bundle.pem"  # missing intermediate
  upload_target: "secrets-store"
  notify: ["sre","security"]
```

sarah_platform: Saving the verified CA chain check command used in remediation:
```
openssl verify -CAfile ca_bundle.pem gateway_bundle.pem
```

matt_oncall: Last note: thumbs on incident severity downgrade once support confirms no outstanding customer errors. I'll update the channel when we close. :thumbsup:
